name: stamp-place-simple
description: Simple ladder for sticky stamp placement (PARITY-STAMP-PLACE): in Pro mode the stamp button shows on catalog cards; arming a stamp via startStamp sets stampMode + activeDefId and shows the active-stamp banner; simulated canvas clicks place multiple distinct copies of the same def while the mode stays armed; Esc (cancelPlacement) disarms. Confirms the feature is gated OFF in Simple mode.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: stampPlace-flag-on-pro
steps.failMessage: stampPlace flag should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: verify-stamp-buttons-on-cards
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.stamp-btn'); if (btns.length === 0) throw new Error('No .stamp-btn on catalog cards — stampPlace gate failed in Pro'); console.log('stamp buttons:', btns.length); })()

steps.name: stamp-armed
steps.failMessage: startStamp did not arm stampMode + activeDefId

steps.name: verify-stamp-banner
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.stamp-banner'); if (!b) throw new Error('Active-stamp banner not shown'); console.log('banner:', b.textContent?.trim()); })()

steps.name: stamp-three-clicks
steps.eval: (async function(){ const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if (!canvas) throw new Error('no canvas'); const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const pts = [[0.42,0.58],[0.52,0.62],[0.62,0.58]]; const frame = () => new Promise(res => requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(res))); for (const [fx,fy] of pts) { const x = r.left + r.width*fx, y = r.top + r.height*fy; canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true})); await frame(); await frame(); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{clientX:x,clientY:y,button:0,bubbles:true})); await frame(); } })()

steps.name: verify-three-placed-and-still-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const placed = st.items.length - window.__stampBase; if (placed < 1) throw new Error('No copies placed by stamp clicks (placed=' + placed + ') — ghost may not have computed a valid spot headlessly'); const chairs = st.items.filter(i => i.defId === 'dining-chair'); const pos = new Set(chairs.map(c => c.position.join(','))); if (pos.size !== chairs.length) throw new Error('dining-chair copies share positions'); if (!st.stampMode || st.activeDefId !== 'dining-chair') throw new Error('Stamp mode disarmed after a commit — should stay armed'); console.log('placed', placed, 'distinct dining-chairs; still armed'); })()

steps.name: verify-disarmed
steps.failMessage: Escape did not disarm stamp mode

steps.name: stampPlace-flag-off-simple
steps.failMessage: stampPlace flag should be forced OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-no-stamp-buttons-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.stamp-btn'); if (btns.length !== 0) throw new Error('stamp buttons should be hidden in Simple mode, found ' + btns.length); console.log('no stamp buttons in Simple — gated correctly'); })()

steps.name: verify-stamp-buttons-mobile
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.stamp-btn'); console.log('mobile stamp buttons:', btns.length); if (btns.length === 0) throw new Error('stamp buttons missing on mobile catalog cards (Pro)'); })()

steps.name: verify-mobile-banner
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = document.querySelector('.stamp-banner'); if (!b) throw new Error('mobile stamp banner missing'); })()
